findings.explanation: `failure_kind` inspects only stdout, but CLI rate-limit diagnostics commonly appear on stderr. Rate-limited calls can therefore be misclassified as `process_failed`, corrupting failure classification and recorded diagnostics.

Return concise findings with exact file and one-based line references. Agent/customer must not see evaluator actions. Invalid decision JSON is an agent protocol error. Unscored trials must remain distinct from zero native reward. Native tools must remain in the environment. All model calls use saved Codex ChatGPT login. No native tools, files, shell, connectors or web. Do not invent bugs or request unrelated features. This is a static code review; you did not execute tests.

35: def validate_customer_stop(previous_agent_text, answer):
36:     """Narrow English confirmation guard; rejects a stop, never fabricates consent."""
37:     if STOP in answer["text"]:
38:         raise CustomerProtocolError("Customer text contains a reserved stop marker")
39:     asks_confirmation = re.search(
40:         r"\b(?:please|kindly)\s+(?:confirm|approve|authorize)\b"
41:         r"|\b(?:do|can|could|will|would)\s+you\s+(?:please\s+)?(?:confirm|approve|authorize)\b"
42:         r"|\breply\b[^\n]*\byes\b"
43:         r"|\b(?:do|would)\s+you\b[^\n?]*\bproceed\b",
44:         previous_agent_text,
45:         re.IGNORECASE,
46:     )
47:     grants_consent = re.match(
48:         r"\s*(yes\b|yep\b|yeah\b|i (confirm|approve)\b|confirmed\b|go ahead\b|please proceed\b)",
49:         answer["text"],
50:         re.IGNORECASE,
51:     )
52:     if answer["done"] and asks_confirmation and grants_consent:
53:         raise CustomerProtocolError(
54:             "Customer cannot stop while answering an action confirmation request"
55:         )

58: def compact_message(message):
59:     result = {"role": message.role}
60:     if message.content is not None:
61:         result["content"] = message.content
62:     if getattr(message, "tool_calls", None):
63:         result["tool_calls"] = [
64:             {"name": call.name, "arguments": call.arguments, "id": call.id}
65:             for call in message.tool_calls
66:         ]
67:     if message.role == "tool":
68:         result.update(id=message.id, error=message.error)
69:     return result

72: class CodexAgent(HalfDuplexAgent):
73:     def __init__(self, client, tools, domain_policy):
74:         super().__init__(tools=tools, domain_policy=domain_policy)
75:         self.client = client
76:         self.schemas = [tool.openai_schema for tool in tools]
77:         self.names = {tool.name for tool in tools}
78: 
79:     def get_init_state(self, message_history=None):
80:         return list(message_history or [])
81: 
82:     def set_seed(self, seed):
83:         # CLI does not expose a sampling seed. Do not imply native seed controls it.
84:         pass
85: 
86:     def generate_next_message(self, message, state):
87:         state.extend(
88:             message.tool_messages
89:             if isinstance(message, MultiToolMessage)
90:             else [message]
91:         )
92:         prompt = participant_prompt(
93:             "agent",
94:             self.domain_policy,
95:             self.schemas,
96:             [compact_message(m) for m in state],
97:         )
98:         try:
99:             answer = self.client.complete(prompt, AGENT_SCHEMA, "agent")
100:         except ValidationError as exc:
101:             raise AgentProtocolError("Agent output does not match its schema") from exc
102:         try:
103:             arguments = json.loads(answer["arguments_json"])
104:         except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError) as exc:
105:             raise AgentProtocolError("Decision arguments are not valid JSON") from exc
106:         if answer["kind"] == "tool":
107:             if answer["text"] or answer["tool_name"] not in self.names:
108:                 raise AgentProtocolError(
109:                     "Invalid tool decision: mixed content or unknown tool"
110:                 )
111:             if not isinstance(arguments, dict):
112:                 raise AgentProtocolError("Tool arguments must be an object")
113:             result = AssistantMessage(
114:                 role="assistant",
115:                 content=None,
116:                 tool_calls=[
117:                     ToolCall(
118:                         id=f"call_{len(state):03}",
119:                         name=answer["tool_name"],
120:                         arguments=arguments,
121:                     )
122:                 ],
123:             )
124:         else:
125:             if not answer["text"].strip() or answer["tool_name"] or arguments != {}:
126:                 raise AgentProtocolError("Invalid customer-facing message")
127:             result = AssistantMessage.text(answer["text"])
128:         state.append(result)
129:         return result, state

132: class CodexCustomer(HalfDuplexUser):
133:     def __init__(self, client, instructions):
134:         super().__init__(instructions=instructions, tools=[])
135:         self.client = client
136: 
137:     def get_init_state(self, message_history=None):
138:         return list(message_history or [])
139: 
140:     def set_seed(self, seed):
141:         pass
142: 
143:     @classmethod
144:     def is_stop(cls, message):
145:         return STOP in (message.content or "")
146: 
147:     def generate_next_message(self, message, state):
148:         if not isinstance(message, AssistantMessage) or message.tool_calls:
149:             raise CustomerProtocolError(
150:                 "Customer must receive only customer-visible assistant text"
151:             )
152:         state.append(message)
153:         try:
154:             answer = self.client.complete(
155:                 participant_prompt(
156:                     "customer",
157:                     self.instructions,
158:                     [],
159:                     [compact_message(m) for m in state],
160:                 ),
161:                 USER_SCHEMA,
162:                 "customer",
163:             )
164:         except ValidationError as exc:
165:             raise CustomerProtocolError(
166:                 "Customer output does not match its schema"
167:             ) from exc
168:         if not any(isinstance(m, UserMessage) for m in state) and answer["done"]:
169:             raise CustomerProtocolError("Customer tried to end before making a request")
170:         if not answer["text"].strip() and not answer["done"]:
171:             raise CustomerProtocolError("Empty customer turn")
172:         validate_customer_stop(message.content or "", answer)
173:         result = UserMessage.text(
174:             answer["text"] + (" " + STOP if answer["done"] else "")
175:         )
176:         state.append(result)
177:         return result, state

180: def run_episode(task, client, trial=0):
181:     environment = get_environment()
182:     orchestrator = Orchestrator(
183:         domain=DOMAIN,
184:         agent=CodexAgent(client, environment.get_tools(), environment.get_policy()),
185:         user=CodexCustomer(client, str(task.user_scenario)),
186:         environment=environment,
187:         task=task,
188:         max_steps=40,
189:         max_errors=3,
190:         timeout=900,
191:         simulation_id=f"{task.id}_trial_{trial}",
192:         validate_communication=True,
193:     )
194:     try:
195:         simulation = run_simulation(orchestrator)
196:     except Exception as exc:
197:         now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
198:         reason = (
199:             TerminationReason.USER_ERROR
200:             if isinstance(exc, CustomerProtocolError)
201:             else TerminationReason.AGENT_ERROR
202:             if isinstance(exc, AgentProtocolError)
203:             else TerminationReason.INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR
204:         )
205:         simulation = SimulationRun(
206:             id=f"{task.id}_trial_{trial}",
207:             task_id=task.id,
208:             start_time=now,
209:             end_time=now,
210:             duration=0.0,
211:             messages=orchestrator.get_messages(),
212:             termination_reason=reason,
213:             info={
214:                 "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
215:                 "error": str(exc),
216:                 "failure_kind": getattr(exc, "kind", "participant_error"),
217:                 "duration_unavailable": True,
218:             },
219:         )
220:     simulation.trial = trial
221:     # Codex subscription usage has no trustworthy per-call dollar amount here.
222:     simulation.agent_cost = None
223:     simulation.user_cost = None
224:     return simulation

50:         if "429" in stdout or "Too Many Requests" in stdout
51:         else "process_failed"
52:     )
53: 
54: 
55: def participant_prompt(role, instructions, tools, conversation):
56:     if role not in {"agent", "customer"}:
57:         raise ValueError("Unknown participant role")
58:     rules = (
59:         "Act as the retail support agent. Follow policy. Choose exactly one tool call "
60:         "or one customer-facing message. For tools set text empty and arguments_json "
61:         "to a JSON object string. For messages set tool_name empty and arguments_json "
62:         "to '{}'. Do not invent tool results. Authenticate and inspect order ownership "
63:         "before private actions. Obtain explicit consent after explaining action details."
64:         if role == "agent"
65:         else "Act as the customer, following your scenario. You do not see private tool "
66:         "calls or database state. Do not invent unknown IDs, tool results, or facts. "
67:         "Answer naturally; only confirm the exact action you want after its details "
68:         "are explained. Set done true only after completion, accepted refusal, or "
69:         "transfer. Never set done true while granting consent or answering an action "
70:         "confirmation request: the agent still needs a turn to execute it and report "
71:         "the result. Your first turn must state your request rather than end the call."
72:     )
73:     return json.dumps(
74:         {
75:             "role": role,
76:             "rules": rules,
77:             "instructions": instructions,
78:             "available_tools": tools,
79:             "conversation": conversation,
80:         },
81:         ensure_ascii=False,
82:         separators=(",", ":"),
83:     )
84: 
85: 
86: def parse_codex_output(stdout, answer_text):
87:     events = [json.loads(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
88:     if any(e.get("type") in {"turn.failed", "error"} for e in events):
89:         raise ValueError("Codex turn failed; inspect private transport log")
90:     for event in events:
91:         item = event.get("item", {})
92:         if item and item.get("type") not in {"agent_message", "reasoning"}:
93:             raise ValueError("Codex attempted a native tool or unexpected item")
94:     completed = [e for e in events if e.get("type") == "turn.completed"]
95:     if len(completed) != 1:
96:         raise ValueError("Missing unique successful completion receipt")
97:     answer = json.loads(answer_text)
98:     if not isinstance(answer, dict):
99:         raise ValueError("Codex answer must be a JSON object")
100:     return answer, completed[0].get("usage", {})

103: class CodexClient:
104:     def __init__(
105:         self, model=None, effort="low", timeout=120, max_calls=80, interval=20
106:     ):
107:         self.binary = shutil.which("codex")
108:         if not self.binary:
109:             raise ValueError("Install Codex CLI and run codex login first")
110:         self.model = model
111:         self.effort = effort
112:         self.timeout = timeout
113:         self.max_calls = max_calls
114:         self.interval = interval
115:         self._last_started = 0.0
116:         self.calls = []
117:         self._attempts = 0
118:         self.version = subprocess.run(
119:             [self.binary, "--version"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
120:         ).stdout.strip()
121:         login = subprocess.run(
122:             [self.binary, "login", "status"], capture_output=True, text=True
123:         )
124:         if login.returncode or "ChatGPT" not in login.stdout + login.stderr:
125:             raise ValueError(
126:                 "This runner requires a saved ChatGPT login; API-key authentication is excluded"
127:             )
128: 
129:     def complete(self, prompt, schema, role):
130:         if self._attempts >= self.max_calls:
131:             raise ValueError("Declared Codex call limit reached")
132:         delay = self.interval - (time.monotonic() - self._last_started)
133:         if delay > 0:
134:             time.sleep(delay)
135:         self._last_started = time.monotonic()
136:         self._attempts += 1
137:         started = time.monotonic()
138:         record = {
139:             "call": self._attempts,
140:             "role": role,
141:             "requested_model": self.model,
142:             "effort": self.effort,
143:             "prompt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest(),
144:             "prompt": json.loads(prompt),
145:             "status": "started",
146:         }
147:         self.calls.append(record)
148:         # Only auth-related HOME/CODEX_HOME locations are inherited, never API keys.
149:         env = {
150:             key: value
151:             for key, value in os.environ.items()
152:             if key
153:             in {
154:                 "PATH",
155:                 "HOME",
156:                 "USER",
157:                 "LOGNAME",
158:                 "TMPDIR",
159:                 "LANG",
160:                 "LC_ALL",
161:                 "CODEX_HOME",
162:                 "SSL_CERT_FILE",
163:                 "SSL_CERT_DIR",
164:                 "HTTPS_PROXY",
165:                 "HTTP_PROXY",
166:                 "NO_PROXY",
167:             }
168:         }
169:         with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="tau3-codex-turn-") as tmp:
170:             work = Path(tmp)
171:             schema_path, answer_path = work / "schema.json", work / "answer.json"
172:             instructions_path = work / "instructions.md"
173:             schema_path.write_text(json.dumps(schema))
174:             instructions_path.write_text(BASE_INSTRUCTIONS)
175:             command = [
176:                 self.binary,
177:                 "exec",
178:                 "--ignore-user-config",
179:                 "--ignore-rules",
180:                 "--ephemeral",
181:                 "--skip-git-repo-check",
182:                 "--sandbox",
183:                 "read-only",
184:                 "--json",
185:                 "--color",
186:                 "never",
187:                 "--output-schema",
188:                 str(schema_path),
189:                 "--output-last-message",
190:                 str(answer_path),
191:                 "--cd",
192:                 str(work),
193:             ]
194:             if self.model:
195:                 command += ["--model", self.model]
196:             config = {
197:                 "approval_policy": '"never"',
198:                 "project_doc_max_bytes": "0",
199:                 "web_search": '"disabled"',
200:                 "skills.max_context_tokens": "1",
201:                 "tools.view_image": "false",
202:                 "model_reasoning_effort": json.dumps(self.effort),
203:                 "model_instructions_file": json.dumps(str(instructions_path)),
204:             }
205:             for feature in (
206:                 "shell_tool",
207:                 "shell_snapshot",
208:                 "apps",
209:                 "plugins",
210:                 "remote_plugin",
211:                 "multi_agent",
212:                 "memories",
213:                 "hooks",
214:                 "browser_use",
215:                 "computer_use",
216:                 "image_generation",
217:                 "workspace_dependencies",
218:                 "skill_search",
219:             ):
220:                 config[f"features.{feature}"] = "false"
221:             for key, value in config.items():
222:                 command += ["-c", f"{key}={value}"]
223:             command += ["-"]
224:             try:
225:                 result = subprocess.run(
226:                     command,
227:                     input=prompt,
228:                     text=True,
229:                     capture_output=True,
230:                     timeout=self.timeout,
231:                     env=env,
232:                 )
233:                 if result.returncode:
234:                     private = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / ".runs" / "transport"
235:                     private.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
236:                     stem = f"call_{self._attempts}_{time.time_ns()}"
237:                     (private / (stem + ".jsonl")).write_text(result.stdout)
238:                     (private / (stem + ".stderr.txt")).write_text(result.stderr)
239:                     record["private_diagnostic"] = ".runs/transport/" + stem
240:                     record["failure_kind"] = failure_kind(result.stdout)
241:                     raise CodexTransportError(record["failure_kind"])
242:                 answer, usage = parse_codex_output(
243:                     result.stdout, answer_path.read_text()
244:                 )
245:                 jsonschema.validate(answer, schema)
246:                 record.update(status="completed", response=answer, usage=usage)
247:                 return answer
248:             except Exception as exc:
249:                 record.update(status="failed", error_type=type(exc).__name__)
250:                 raise
251:             finally:
252:                 record["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)

prompt.context: Final static review after two findings were addressed with failing regression tests followed by fixes: malformed nested JSON including non-string fault injection maps to agent_error; JSON-schema failures are translated at each participant boundary to agent_error or user_error. Native tools and evaluator remain unchanged. The stop guard is explicitly a narrow English heuristic, not full semantic intent detection. Assess concrete remaining defects in the final supplied code.

findings.explanation: `failure_kind` inspects only stdout, but CLI rate-limit diagnostics commonly appear on stderr. Rate-limited calls can therefore be misclassified as `process_failed`, corrupting failure classification and recorded diagnostics.
